title: stream: clarify readiness docs for basic streams
body:
## What

- Clarify the readiness docs for `iter`, `once`, and `empty`.

## Why

- These streams can return `Poll::Pending` for cooperative scheduling.
- The docs still said they were always or immediately ready.

## Implementation

- Update documentation only.
- No behavior changes.
